We no longer had to install and manage fixed license sets, which allowed us to focus 100% on the design at hand and tapeout our chiplet solutions several months faster than with traditional methods.”

Synopsys Cloud is a chip design automation platform that enables you to manage and access EDA licenses instantly from on-premises or from the cloud. Synopsys Cloud offers a unique FlexEDA business model with patented license management automation and metering service that allows designers to scale EDA workloads with extreme flexibility. It also features a Synopsys-managed SaaS infrastructure option that delivers a comprehensive EDA design environment.
Fully automated license management service with license server auto-scaling
Pay-per-use access to unlimited licenses by-the-minute via FlexEDA
Instant purchase and activation of term-based licenses via a web portal
Pre-defined flows to jumpstart Analog, Digital, Verification and Photonics designs
